comment: Released versions of ctm-checkers and what each is: the sha256 of its contents (the wheel's RECORD, which lists every file with its hash), of the wheel file and of the page script ctm-checkers.js. A release never changes: tools/build.py --check fails when the code, the wheel or the script of a released version differ from its entry, and a development version must be above every release. Without tags (step-2 design §13), this keeps a version and its HTML dependency path (site_libs/quarto-contrib/ctm-checkers-<version>/) for one content only, so browsers cannot keep a stale copy. The release PR adds its entry with `python tools/build.py --release`; the first change after it sets the next development version (X.Y.Z.devN, dependency version X.Y.Z.devN+<sha8 of the wheel>).
